summary: A university department, faculty or research institute: masthead with a course search, admissions, research groups, seminars, faculty, a programmes page with a course finder and a people directory.

pages.purpose: Orient prospective students, current students and researchers: search courses, see admissions, research and what is on this week.

sections.purpose: Department name under the institution, one-line focus, and a course search that lands on the course finder.
fields: Decorative artwork or photo of the building
sections.notes: The search is a GET form (role=search) that prefills the finder with ?q= and ?level=. Drawn artwork is decorative.

sections.purpose: Admissions as a ruled table: programme, level, deadline, places, language.
Research groups with their focus and lead.
alternatives: entity-card: few groups shown with a photo and lead

sections.purpose: Seminars and events as a dated list.
Faculty members with research interests, linking to the directory.

pages.purpose: Compare degrees, find a course and learn how to apply.

sections.purpose: The degree programmes side by side (duration, credits, language, places).

Every course, filtered by level, term, format and language, with free-text search over codes, titles, descriptions and lecturers, a 'free seats only' switch and sort orders; each entry shows a seat meter and opens to its description, prerequisites and room.
alternatives: data-table: staff-facing catalogues with many columns
sections.notes: role=search on the filters; result count in a status region; seat meters need a text value.

sections.purpose: How to apply, step by step.

pages.purpose: The staff directory grouped by rank: title, research interests, group, office and office hours.

sections.purpose: Staff grouped by rank with contact details.
alternatives: team: a small department with photos

content: Department and institution names, address and contact
Degree programmes: level, duration, credits, language, places, requirements
Course catalogue with codes, lecturers, rooms, times, seats
Research groups with focus and leads
Staff directory: titles, interests, offices, office hours, emails
Approval from the institution for the use of its name and logo
Data source/update routine for courses and seats

styles.name: corporate serif
styles.why: Serif headings over a reading sans, mono for codes and rooms, a deep burgundy-like accent and restrained motion: an institution, not a launch.

styles.name: research lab
styles.why: Dense and technical for research institutes and labs.

pitfalls: Course and seat data that goes stale; show when it was last updated and the source.
Seat meters shown only as bars; give a text value.
Admission deadlines without time zone or with the wrong academic year.
Staff emails exposed without the institution's policy, or departed staff still listed.
Using the university's name or logo against its brand rules.
A finder that cannot be reached by keyboard or does not announce result counts.
